scenarios.prompt: A game stacks a menu pause, a cutscene hold and a local slow-motion effect. Define stable pause requests, arbitration and restoration against project-owned clocks.

criteria.arbitration: Overlapping requests resolve deterministically and release only their own scope.
criteria.ownership: Engine adapters map policy to clocks; hitstop, UI focus, audio and network authority remain separate owners.
